title: FancyZones experimental 'move newly created windows to current active monitor' shifts window with Greenshot

judgment.rationale: The reporter describes a Greenshot capture offset while FancyZones' experimental new-window placement is enabled. A maintainer provided an exclusion workaround, and two commenters confirmed it works. The original reporter has not confirmed whether the workaround resolves their report or whether the bug persists on a current build; ask only for that status and do not propose a competing design.
evidence: The original report uses PowerToys 0.75.1, Windows 10 Enterprise, Excel 365, and Greenshot 1.2.10.
The maintainer's workaround is to exclude the 'Greenshot capture form' from FancyZones placement.
Two commenters confirmed that exclusion workaround resolved the same symptom for them.
No linked implementation or current-build confirmation is identified.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask the original reporter whether the documented Greenshot exclusion resolves the offset and whether it still reproduces on a current build.

fix_assessment.rationale: The comments provide a working per-application workaround, not a linked code fix. The current report does not establish that a broader code change is required.

issue_context.summary: With FancyZones' experimental active-monitor option enabled, opening Greenshot's capture form shifts a fullscreen Excel window and offsets the captured image by roughly one title bar.
known_information: Original configuration: PowerToys 0.75.1, Windows 10 Enterprise 19044, Excel 365, Greenshot 1.2.10, and a 1x3 FancyZones layout on an extended monitor.
The maintainer advised excluding the window named 'Greenshot capture form' from FancyZones.
Two commenters reported that the exclusion workaround resolved their symptom.
The original author has not confirmed whether the workaround or a current build resolves their case.
inferences: FancyZones moving the Greenshot capture form is consistent with the workaround, but the reported Excel shift is not conclusively traced to a particular code path.
A working application-specific exclusion may be sufficient for affected users; there is no evidence here that a general placement change is required.
issue_context.analysis: Preserve the known workaround and ask the original reporter whether it resolves the case. Avoid competing design proposals until the remaining behavior is confirmed.
initial_investigation: Read the complete issue body and all three comments, including two confirmations of the maintainer-provided exclusion workaround.
Checked the related FancyZones window-placement path; the discussion does not establish a root cause or linked code change.

information_gaps.information: Whether excluding 'Greenshot capture form' resolves the original reporter's Excel capture offset and whether it persists on a current PowerToys build.
information_gaps.why_needed: The workaround is confirmed by other users, but the original reporter has not said whether it addresses this particular window arrangement.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Please confirm whether the FancyZones exclusion fixes the offset, and whether the same issue remains on the current version.

comment.body: The suggested workaround is to exclude the FancyZones window named "Greenshot capture form"; two commenters report that this resolved the same offset for them. Could you confirm whether that exclusion fixes the Excel capture shift in your setup, and whether the problem still occurs on a current PowerToys build?
